linkedin_about: I am a Masters in Computer Vision graduate from Carnegie Mellon University. At CMU, I worked with Prof. Aswin S. in the Image Science Lab exploring the domains of neural rendering and computational photography. I completed a research internship with the Virtual Humans team at TikTok R&D during the summer 2022 where I worked on a generative model for clothed full-body virtual humans. Prior to CMU, I received my B.Tech (Hons.) in CS from International Institute of Information Technology, Hyderabad, India where I pursued research in computer vision under Dr. P.J. Narayanan
